name: Balatro-TS-TW
blurb: Spinning kaleidoscopic shader pattern that responds to mouse movement.
description: Complex WebGL shader creating a rotating fractal-like pattern with three customizable colors. Responds to mouse position and includes pixelation, contrast, and spin controls. Uses ogl for shader management and runs continuous RAF animation.
use_when: Interactive background for gaming or music-related sites, where the mouse-reactive effect creates engagement and visual feedback.
avoid_when: Low-end devices or mobile; the continuous shader loop and mouse tracking are resource-intensive.
a11y: WebGL canvas with no semantic content. Mouse interaction is optional (mouseInteraction prop). No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
